displayName: AI resources should have a system-assigned managed identity enabled
description: Audit AI resources whose identity.type does not include SystemAssigned: Cognitive Services accounts (all kinds, including Foundry and Azure OpenAI), Foundry projects, Azure ML workspaces, registries, online and batch endpoints, AmlCompute and compute instances, Azure AI Search, Health Bot, de-identification services, and Video Indexer. User-assigned-only resources are reported. Bot Service has no ARM managed identity and is not assessed. Audit is the default.

builtInReview.gap: Among 2862 live built-ins, only fe3fd216 (B11, Cognitive Services only) checks identity.type, and it accepts user-assigned-only identities. 5f0c7d88 (B12) requires user-assigned identity on ML workspaces. No built-in requires a system-assigned identity.

metadata.description: Audit reports AI resources without a system-assigned managed identity. Deny is available only for a separate explicit assignment.
